Elombe Kisala — Designer, Developer, Filmmaker, and Entrepreneur

Who I am
I’m Elombe Kisala, a multidisciplinary creator and entrepreneur based between Jersey City and New York City. I’m building creative businesses—and documenting the process. I design websites, create content, and develop digital systems that turn ideas into real businesses.

Primary message
I’m building creative businesses—and documenting the process.

Studio
SWFT Studios (https://swftstudios.com/) is my creative studio for conversion-focused websites, photography, video, and digital systems. Commercial service inquiries should go to SWFT—not this personal site as a job application.
